name: City Island Bridge
facts: The original City Island Bridge, opened in 1901, spanned 950 feet and featured a central swing span that was deactivated in 1963, turning the once-mobile crossing into a fixed roadway.
In 2015 a temporary steel bridge collapsed, prompting a December 16, 2015 road test with fire trucks to reassure residents before the new causeway opened on October 29, 2017.
The 2014 redesign abandoned a controversial cable‑stayed tower, opting instead for a shorter, 17‑foot wider causeway that preserves the island’s low‑rise aesthetic while adding a bicycle lane.
